scenario: A rule fires when its conditions become true (LSCO.2.2.1): Motion is asserted and pumped, then the matching Lock is asserted and pumped, and `secure_motion` fires exactly once over the run, so it fired when the second fact arrived and no other time.
rules_ds:
schema Motion scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Bool mutable

schema Lock scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    locked: Bool mutable

rule secure_motion:
    Motion m where m.state == true
    Lock l where l.locked == false and m.entity_id == l.entity_id
->
    log info "motion in unlocked area"
